action: The head and neck bob slightly in place while the muzzle shortens and then stretches back out, with no travel across the frame.
identity_gap: Proportion: in the frames the head and muzzle are much larger and the neck is shorter and more upright than in the doodle, and the top crop cuts off the ossicones (the P-shaped horn), so the giraffe reads as a horse.
notes: The stroke vocabulary matches the doodle stroke for stroke (square ear, arrow eye, jaw notch, mouth tick, the cross-tick on the neck), so it is clearly the same drawing. The problems are the enlarged head with its cropped top, which loses the subject, and the muzzle snapping shorter at frame 5 and back at frame 7 instead of easing.
